mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, it is 59 degrees under overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a full moon tonight. The ISS passes overhead, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will be 48 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has updated its engineering services reports, which are reviewed at each Council meeting, with the most recent report from October 26. Additionally, WisDOT is hosting meetings on the US 18/151 Corridor Study to gather public feedback on design concepts.

We have a busy couple of days ahead with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia both taking place today. Looking forward to tomorrow, you can enjoy pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, trivia at The Bogey Factory, or yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a noteworthy call from October 19, officers stopped a 49-year-old local man for driving with a suspended license, which led to his arrest on an active warrant.
Culver's is currently open until 10:00 PM, so stop by to enjoy today's featured flavor, Chocolate Caramel Twist.
